description: Write and run the unit test suite covering ModelService, PredictionService, and HistoryService. Also add sign information mapping (sign_info.py) and dataset class counts to config. Depends on FEAT-001. Independent of FEAT-002 (tests do not require the GUI).
steps: 1. Create src/sign_info.py — SIGN_INFO dict mapping class_id (0–42) to a dict with keys: name (from signs.classes[id+1]), category (one of: Speed Limits, Prohibitory, Mandatory, Warning, Other), meaning (1-sentence plain English meaning), driving_tip (1-sentence driving interpretation). Populate all 43 entries. Example: 0: {'name':'Speed limit (20km/h)','category':'Speed Limits','meaning':'Maximum speed 20 km/h in this zone.','driving_tip':'Reduce speed immediately to 20 km/h or below.'}. This data is used by predict_page.py to show the sign information card.

2. Update src/config.py to add DATASET_CLASS_COUNTS dict with the actual per-class image counts discovered during exploration: {0:157, 1:1980, 2:2010, 3:1260, 4:1770, 5:1650, 6:360, 7:1290, 8:1260, 9:1320, 10:1800, 11:1170, 12:1890, 13:1920, 14:690, 15:540, 16:360, 17:990, 18:1080, 19:180, 20:300, 21:270, 22:330, 23:450, 24:240, 25:1350, 26:540, 27:210, 28:480, 29:240, 30:390, 31:630, 32:270, 33:689, 34:420, 35:1200, 36:390, 37:210, 38:2010, 39:300, 40:360, 41:240, 42:240}. Note: these are approximate — the coder should use actual counts from the datasettraffic/ dir by scanning at runtime once on DatasetPage and caching, OR hardcode the values from exploration (total must equal 34776). If the sum does not match 34776, scan dynamically instead.

3. Create tests/test_model_service.py — unittest.TestCase. Uses unittest.mock to avoid loading the real model in CI. Tests: test_singleton_returns_same_instance, test_get_model_info_returns_required_keys (mocked), test_load_called_once (mock assert). Also one integration test (marked to skip if model file missing): test_real_model_loads_and_predicts — loads real model, creates a dummy 1x32x32x1 float32 array, calls predict, checks output shape is (1,43) and all values sum to ~1.0.

4. Create tests/test_prediction_service.py — unittest.TestCase. Tests with a real small test image from Output Images/ (o4.jpeg). Tests: test_predict_returns_required_keys — calls predict() on the test image, asserts result has keys predicted_class, predicted_label, confidence, top3, is_low_confidence, processing_time_ms. test_predicted_class_in_valid_range — pred_class is int 0–42. test_top3_sorted_descending — top3[0].probability >= top3[1].probability >= top3[2].probability. test_label_matches_signs_dict — signs.classes[result['predicted_class']+1] == result['predicted_label']. test_confidence_is_float_0_to_1 — 0.0 <= confidence <= 1.0. test_invalid_image_raises_error — passing None or a blank array raises ValueError or similar.

5. Create tests/test_history_service.py — unittest.TestCase. Uses a temp directory for the history JSON file (patch HISTORY_FILE in config). Tests: test_add_record_persists — add a record, reload HistoryService, get_all() returns it. test_get_all_newest_first — add 3 records with different timestamps, get_all() returns newest first. test_max_history_trimmed — add MAX_HISTORY+5 records, length is MAX_HISTORY. test_clear_history — after clear, get_all() returns []. test_get_stats_returns_keys — get_stats() returns dict with total_predictions, most_common_sign, avg_confidence. test_export_csv — exports CSV with correct headers (id, timestamp, predicted_label, confidence). Uses setUp/tearDown to create and clean temp dirs.

6. Run the full test suite and fix any failures before marking complete. Command: C:\Users\Mahek\AppData\Local\Programs\Python\Python311\python.exe -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -v. All tests must pass (integration tests that need GUI are skipped with @unittest.skip or conditional skipIf).

7. Update predict_page.py (from FEAT-002) to use SIGN_INFO from sign_info.py: after showing prediction result, add a 'Sign Information' collapsible section (CTkFrame, initially shown) displaying category, meaning, and driving_tip for the predicted sign. If sign_info not found for a class_id, skip the section gracefully.
